image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a classic car wheel. The wheel features a chrome or polished aluminum rim with a distinct raised lip and a five-spoke alloy design in the center. A black rubber tire with a white sidewall stripe (whitewall) is mounted on the rim. The central hub has a circular cap. Part of the red car body (fender/wheel well) is visible at the top right, and the ground (asphalt/concrete) is visible at the bottom.

artifact_observations.reasoning: There is a string of nonsensical characters/symbols in the bottom right corner, resembling a corrupted watermark or AI-generated text artifact.

The transition between the whitewall stripe and the black rubber is slightly soft and lacks the crisp molding line typically seen in real tires. The texture of the rubber appears somewhat smudged rather than granular.

The reflections on the spokes are slightly inconsistent with the single light source implied by the rim highlights, suggesting minor geometric or rendering inconsistencies in the complex reflective surfaces.

To check for edge bleeding or fusion between the metal rim and the rubber tire, especially around the whitewall stripe.
